summary: Configured persistent, source-restricted SNMPv2c monitoring from node2 to node1. System identity, uptime, contact, and location are readable; writes return noAccess. Both nodes retained RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64, and the asset register remained unchanged. Sequential restart verification passed on both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed EL7-compatible Net-SNMP 5.7.2 server and client components.
Restricted SNMP access to node2, UDP/161, and the system OID branch.
Configured sysLocation as West Branch and sysContact as ops@branch.test.
Enabled snmpd and persisted the source-restricted firewall rule.
Verified permitted reads, hidden out-of-branch data, and rejected writes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: SNMP identity, uptime, location, and contact are readable from node2
evidence.summary: Successful SNMPv2c reads returned sysDescr, sysUpTime, sysContact, and sysLocation before and after restarts.
Writes returned noAccess, sysLocation remained unchanged, no write community exists, and configuration is restricted to the system OID branch.
The register remained present and retained SHA-256 da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Retain legacy operating system and kernel with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 and EL7 Net-SNMP 5.7.2 packages.
